hypothesis: W-R16B pooled temporal mismatch failed on subtle adjacent swaps although it detected coarse reorderings. Test whether replacing two coarse training-negative families with local variants improves recognition of unseen local changes without widening models, epochs or training examples.
freeze: This specific factor design, data generation, seed split, budgets, outcomes and thresholds is frozen before any original evaluation. W-R16B heldout is not reused; no retuning on its scores.
generator: Reuse W-R16B original 16x4 input formula and genuine per-tick four-channel jitter `(11*t+7*channel+3*entity+seed) % (2*amp+1)-amp`; anchor fixed, candidate shift+17 development and +79 heldout.
test_families: offset_pair_swaps: swap tail indices (1,2),(3,4)...(13,14), leaving tail index 0
single_middle_adjacent_swap: swap tail indices 6 and 7 only
learning: Each of 6 model/curriculum arms trains on exactly 1728 development pairs (16 seeds,9 entities,3 transform families,2 train noise amps,2 labels), 16 weights+bias, zero init, learning rate0.1, 32 ordered epochs. Same model budget; do not peek at heldout for selection.
primary: Evaluate both unseen local heldout families at amplitudes 1,2,3, 16 sealed seeds x9 entities x2 labels. Report six independent cells, per-seed confusion, aggregates for all 6 arms. MIXED_CURRICULUM_GAIN iff local_mixed improves >=0.05 aggregate over global_only for BOTH mean_mismatch and transition; TRADEOFF iff any local_mixed model improves >=0.05 but gain condition fails; otherwise NO_CROSS_FEATURE_GAIN. Preserve negative/mixed outcomes.
controls: Frozen W-R16B source blob sha and parent identity
Identical paired multiset and first row for positive vs negative candidate
No direct heldout calibration, labels or updates
Single first-use artifact and one full regression, fail-closed on identity/provenance/scope drift
claim_limit: Finite supervised synthetic local order discrimination, not general language cognition or accepted ref promotion.
